about: Downloaded shield models that take the place of a Codex-made one (sneed 2026-11-28: 'use an actual shield model if there are any, to see how it looks'). tools/shield_download.py fetches each zip into assets/raw/<raw>/ and packs the textures; tools/shield_real.py (Blender) writes game/Content/ThirdParty/Shields/<id>.glb over the Codex one in the same frame (centred, face to +x, straps behind, up +z), sized to `diameter` metres; the ShieldArt commandlet imports it. Licences in assets/manifest.json.
